Most legal problems are loud.
Good advice is quiet.
Harrow & Vale advises founders, families and quiet companies on the matters they'd rather never became stories. Most of our best work is invisible, which suits everyone.
First conversations are free and assumed confidential.
Formation to exit: cap tables, financings, the deals that should close quietly and do.
Litigation when unavoidable, settlement architecture when wiser. We bill for outcomes, not theatre.
Hiring, exits and the documents that keep both sides dignified. For companies and the occasional executive.
Estates, trusts and family matters, handled with the discretion your dinner table deserves.
in transactions closed the boring way: on time, unreported
of disputes resolved before a courtroom needed dusting
average tenure of our three founding families of clients
matters declined to matters taken. Focus is the product
They are the only lawyers I've met who regard a crisis averted as more billable than a crisis won.
General counsel, a company you know
The person who pitched you is the person who advises you. Delegation happens behind our door, not yours.
Every opinion ends with a single page saying what we'd do. The forty pages of reasoning are attached, not required.
If the answer is unwelcome, you hear it first and from us. Surprise is the one thing we never bill for.
Eleven lawyers, no juniors on your matter
The cheapest legal advice is the kind sought early. The first conversation costs nothing but candour.
